text: 2026年11月3日，中国人民银行与印度尼西亚银行举行联合工作机制工作会议。中国人民银行副行长宣昌能、印度尼西亚银行副行长托马斯·吉万多诺出席会议，双方就联合工作机制合作进展以及下阶段双边金融合作重点交换了意见。
text_en: On November 3, 2026, the People's Bank of China and Bank Indonesia held a joint working mechanism meeting. PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng and Bank Indonesia Deputy Governor Thomas Jiwandono attended the meeting, and the two sides exchanged views on the progress of cooperation under the joint working mechanism and the priorities of bilateral financial cooperation in the next stage.
